candidates.why: Line 1190 assigns klass->appname = bit_read_TV(dat) (heap, see bits.c:1536). At line 1194 it is free()'d but the pointer is NOT set to NULL, and the loop breaks before dwg->num_classes++ (line 1236). The dangling pointer stays in dwg->dwg_class[i].appname. Any later reader of that slot (e.g. out_dxf.c:3042 / out_dxfb.c:1830 VALUE_T(dwg->dwg_class[j].appname), encode.c:2209/2212, or free.c:1299 FREE_IF) would touch freed memory if the slot is ever counted/reused. Suspicious free-without-null.

After free(klass->appname) at 1194 the code breaks, but the same klass slot is re-memset at 1183 only on the NEXT loop iteration; if the loop instead exits, the freed appname pointer remains live in the array. The TRACE log at 1213 (klass->appname) is on the non-break path so not directly hit, but the pattern of freeing a struct field without NULLing it (1194) leaves a dangling field that downstream class consumers (out_dxf.c:3042, free.c:1299) can read.
